# Overlay: user-review-gates

<!-- NOTE (example-only): Contains example tokens for gate workflows. Not runtime secrets. -->

## Load

- `bthwani-interactive-review`

## Add Only When

- the task crosses a major visual or directional approval boundary
- the first shell, first screen family, first major pattern, or first major redesign is involved
- the next step would commit to a reusable standard or broad visual direction

## Do Not Add When

- the work is low-risk internal forensics
- the work is non-visual cleanup
- the work is only target-fit or source-trace analysis
